items.title: 67520_George Handy oral history interview
items.q: This is the time that I babysat for Bruce Raeburn, Bruce and Susan--

ctx.x: Carbondale, Illinois it was thump, thump, thump. The same was true with pianos. A Rhodes maybe isn't the most musical thing in the world, but at least all the notes worked. And for the record, talk about the days when a piano didn't work.

This happened to me, in particular with the Raeburn band--I don't remember the year--it was in the early days of the band, probably--I would take a guess and say 1945-- this was In New Jersey and it was a place called the West End Casino and we had the job there for the summer, we all lived in nearby roominghouses. This is the time that I babysat for Bruce Raeburn, Bruce and Susan--
(Side B of Tape 5 ended at this point. Transcript will continue in accordance with Tape 6.)
